rule: Typed G1 decisions. Each is applied in code, planted by a test that fails without it (tests/test_g1_decisions.py), and recorded in the tracker artefact (G1_TRACKER.json['decisions'], the topic file it changes, and the page). Made by Mahmood, or by the captain under his delegation as stated per entry.

decisions.rule: A trial's own posted results in a versioned AACT snapshot count as a PRIMARY source on the page (route SWEEP_AACT_PRIMARY), only with the recorded registry binding: NCT, the registry outcome title, the snapshot id + digest, the posted-N = randomised-N guard, and two-arm counts or a two-sided effect with its CI. Anything missing is not counted (fail-closed).

ONE_COMPARABLE_TRIAL passes RESULT_AGREES only when the directly comparable pairs that AGREE carry at least half of the shared trials' participants AND every other shared pair is a named MEASURE_DIFFERENCE with the same conclusion. A pair without a participant count, or a shared pair that is neither, fails closed. One small trial never carries a topic. Participants come from the pair's arm counts, else from the trial's OWN held abstract stating its randomised N (verb before the number, never negated or future, exactly one N; span recorded) -- g1_tracker.stated_randomised_n (corpus: 35 of 296 comparator trials with a held abstract state one).

A comparator that pools no RCTs cannot be matched trial-for-trial by an RCT review: the topic stays in the denominator with status COMPARATOR_POOLS_NO_RCT, a span quoted verbatim from the comparator's own held record, and is listed on the page as not attainable against this comparator. Replacing the comparator is Mahmood's decision.

span.text: Twelve eligible observational studies (n = 1,627,434) were enrolled.

statins-primary-prevention-elderly.flag: FOR MAHMOOD: replace the comparator (an RCT meta-analysis of statins in older adults) or keep the topic as not attainable

decisions.rule: A meta whose figure prints no pooled result cannot reproduce its own pool (no positive control): its rows count only as a SECOND source beside a gated meta or a primary, never alone (SECOND_SOURCE_ONLY).

A cluster or cluster-crossover trial's unadjusted arm counts are not pooled as if individually randomised: without a unit-of-analysis adjustment the trial is blocked UNIT_OF_ANALYSIS_ADJUSTMENT_UNAVAILABLE (SALT, SMART) and the comparator's unadjusted use is a comparator finding.
A substudy / secondary analysis of a randomised comparison is a report of that RCT unless its own record says it is non-randomised, post hoc or observational; protocol / design papers stay excluded.
decisions.applied_in: harness/screen.py:_title_not_an_rct_report (g1/finish-line) -- NOT YET in the consolidation: it changes the SERVED screen, so its served-number changes are listed as notices in the next PR #13 packet before it lands

decisions.rule: A confidence interval RE-EXPRESSED from another printed level (e.g. EXAMINE's FDA-label 98% CI 0.80-1.16 converted to 95% 0.8209-1.1227) is kept for MATCHING only (the G1 tracker may verify a trial with it) and NEVER enters a served pool: a served row's numbers must be printed verbatim in a held span. The served-pool register refuses such a row (build_served_pool_additions.pipeline_row: no verbatim span) and the notice generator excludes it as NOT_ADMISSIBLE_BY_REGISTER (g1_served_pool_notices.topic_notice; plant tests/test_served_pool_notice_admissible.py).
